server_url.label: Fingerprint server URL
server_url.description: HTTPS address of the fingerprint server. HTTP is allowed only for localhost.

api_key.label: Recognition API key
api_key.description: A key with read access to the fingerprint server.

application_key.label: Application key
application_key.description: Required when the fingerprint server uses the APISIX gateway.

sources.label: Live inputs to recognize
sources.description: Only selected live inputs that allow audio analysis are recognized. Audio stays in memory; fingerprints are sent to the configured server.

manifest.description: Recognizes music from selected live inputs using a fingerprint server.
